queries_run: Trane Technologies China tariff OR trade restriction OR export control 2026

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 風險因素：美國已對多國商品加徵關稅並引發報復性關稅，另可能有進出口管制，公司稱無法預測關稅範圍，且限制可能無預警實施
findings.excerpt: The U.S. continues to implement certain trade actions, including imposing tariffs on certain goods imported from several countries, which has resulted in retaliatory tariffs by other countries. Additional tariffs have been proposed by the current U.S. administration and there are active negotiations for extending trade treaties. It is not possible to predict the extent or focus of any such tariffs at this time.

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 MD&A：公司持續監控2025年美國關稅與他國報復關稅，可能面臨供應鏈挑戰與商品成本波動；稱 in-region for region 策略可因應；約75%營收來自美國
findings.excerpt: These global trade policy changes continue to be dynamic and, as a result, we may experience supply chain challenges, commodity cost volatility, and consumer and economic uncertainty. We believe our business operating system, our in-region for region strategy, and strength in execution will enable us to navigate potential risks stemming from these recent events.

reg_tariff_export.note: 搜尋僅見二手摘要（2025年關稅成本約>$1.4億、2026-06-01 Section 232 HVAC設備稅率25%→15%至2027-12-31），未取得逐字原文，列入 clues；未找到Trane出口管制/實體清單事件。

clues.claim: 2026-06-01 公告將部分 HVAC 與農業設備 Section 232 關稅由25%降至15%，至2027-12-31
clues.source: JD Supra: President Trump Reduces Section 232 Tariffs on Certain Agricultural, Mobile Industrial, and HVAC Equipment

clues.claim: Q4 2025 財報電話會議：2025年關稅成本略高於1.4億美元，預期2026年有更多通膨影響
